title: Skilled-Stay Coinsurance Reserve on Resident Funds: Where the Run Ends
content:
Before an ancillary per-bill authorization amount is set on a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, the spare balance is reduced by a reserve for the coinsurance on the run of the resident's active episode under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage. **The run's end follows the stay**, as the episode record and any reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations show it:

| What the records show | The run ends on |
|---|---|
| the active episode carries a last covered date before today | that last covered date |
| no such date is set, and a bed hold is in progress because the resident is away | the day before the leave began |
| otherwise | yesterday |

## Both sides (hypothetical dates; today is 15 February)

| Records | Run starting 4 February ends | Run days |
|---|---|---|
| last covered date 9 February | 9 February | 6 |
| last covered date 15 February (not before today); no hold | 14 February | 11 |
| no last covered date; resident on leave since 12 February | 11 February | 8 |
| no last covered date; no hold in progress | 14 February | 11 |

## Basis Q&A

**The episode shows a last covered date later than today and the resident is in hospital on a bed hold.** The last covered date is not before today, so the run ends on the day before the leave began.
